subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain open as the combined tracker for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of the narrower open items?
rationale: Current main implements useful pieces but not the full requested contract, and automation should not choose the permanent tracker shape across Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review a structured reply metadata contract and the final fallback delivery issue remains open.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers explicitly confirm the reply metadata and final-fallback work are fully represented by the narrower linked items.

options.title: Accept Current Quote Text
options.body: Treat Markdown quote text plus generic runtime context as enough for Control UI replies, which narrows scope but leaves the original structured metadata request intentionally unsupported.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review a structured reply metadata contract and the final fallback delivery issue remains open.
